text:
maria_cs: FYI Satori needs a short staging window for a product demo. Request: control-plane allowlist + temp rate-limit bump + route demo traffic to eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1 for latency. Window is 10h next Thurs UTC.

jake_infra: Need IP ranges, exact rps, and whether this is Hosted keys. Also will require a rollback plan and logging tag.

maria_cs: Hosted keys. IPs: 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.128/25. Requested rate: 30 -> 250 req/s (per-key aggregated). Scope: staging only, control-plane hostname.

sam_support: Please tag logs/billing so CS can track cost. Also want synthetic check from SG before demo.

emma_se: Do not change prod routing. Flagging as renewal opportunity if demo succeeds.

jake_infra: I'll create change ticket, stage 10% canary, alert on error-rate >1.5% or p95>600ms, tag as satori-demo-2026.

ops-bot: Change created: CS-5102 / INF-10100. Pre-check scheduled.

jake_infra: Canary OK 20m. No errors. Rolling to full window at start time. Will post SG synthetic at T-45.

maria_cs: Demo successful; Satori saw improved latency and no incidents. Follow-up: post-mortem + renewal outreach. Thanks team :tada:
